title: Lock the supported loopback-only exposure path
verify: Independent verification proves the documented executable start uses 127.0.0.1, local smoke remains healthy, no host/LAN/CORS/bearer mode is exposed, and public smoke responses contain no product/auth data.
evidence_required: FT-015-AC-002 RED/GREEN: establish honest pre-implementation evidence for the supported launch/config surface; GREEN requires the executable runbook/bootstrap contract to bind 127.0.0.1, expose no LAN/host/CORS/bearer setting, and keep public smoke product/auth-free; decisive comparison: launch/config scan plus local smoke results; artifact: runtime-policy transcript under .tasks/TASK-063-T3-FT-015-W1/. Pre-implementation GREEN is preserved without unnecessary production change.
purpose: Make the accepted absence of optional LAN mode an executable security result while retaining the one supported loopback runtime.
success_outcome: The supported local launch is unambiguously loopback-only, health/readiness work locally, and the current product exposes no configurable LAN/CORS/bearer access mode; future LAN work must return to design.
anti_goals: Do not implement LAN, host override, CORS middleware/config, bearer transport, TLS, certificate handling, or remote smoke.
Do not broaden public health/readiness data.
constraints: Treat LAN as not applicable for FT-015, not as an untested hidden mode.
Use local deterministic smoke only; no external interface/network authorization is granted.
invariants: Every supported first-demo backend launch binds loopback.
Optional LAN controls cannot be claimed until an explicit implementation/design task exists.
verification_targets: FT-015-AC-002: source/config/runbook plus local smoke prove loopback-only support and absence of LAN mode.

forbidden_scope: LAN/CORS/TLS/bearer implementation, remote network probing, frontend, server sync, or provider egress.
stop_conditions: Current production code already exposes a non-loopback mode requiring a product/security decision.
Proof would require probing another machine or changing host firewall/network state.
